chunks: Al-Kafi: Ali, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Verily the All-Mighty, the Almighty, has sent down unto you His Book, and He is Truthful and Good. In it is news of you, news of those who came before you, news of those who will come after you, and news of Heaven and Earth. If there comes to you one who can inform you of that, you will be amazed.

key_terms.السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ: Heaven and Earth (cosmic scope of Quranic knowledge)
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ الْبَارُّ: The Truthful and the Good/Excelling (Divine Attributes)
key_terms.خَبَرُكُمْ: News/Information of you (referring to the present generation)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran contain according to Imam al-Sadiq (AS)?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the Quran's nature as the comprehensive record (*khabar*) of all existence, encompassing the past, present, and future, as well as the celestial and terrestrial realms. This aligns with the Shia scholarly understanding of the Quran as the 'Great Book' (*al-Kitab al-Akbar*) that contains the secrets of the universe, reflecting the divine attribute of *Al-Alim* (The All-Knowing). The mention of 'news' (*khabar*) emphasizes its role not just as a legal code, but as a cosmic narrative that reveals the hidden realities of creation.
